title: Continual Tool-Space Extension Learning for Multimodal Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.23810v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal agents largely rely on generic tools such as cropping, search, and code execution, leaving specialist vision models outside their tool space. However, bringing such a model into an already trained agent is not straightforward. The challenge is to learn each new tool efficiently while retaining the ability to use existing ones. This work proposes COTEX, continual tool-space extension learning, that adds new tools at efficient adapter-level cost. COTEX locates two sets of parameter directions; one triggers a tool call and thereby opens a multi-turn reasoning trajectory, while the other determines which tool is chosen. The adapter of a new tool is restricted to the calling directions that leave earlier tool choices unaffected by orthogonal constraint. translated_title: 面向多模态智能体的持续工具空间扩展学习
translated_abstract: 多模态智能体在很大程度上依赖于裁剪、搜索和代码执行等通用工具，而将专业视觉模型排除在其工具空间之外。然而，将此类模型引入一个已经训练完成的智能体并非易事。其挑战在于如何高效地学习每个新工具，同时保留使用已有工具的能力。本工作提出了COTEX（持续工具空间扩展学习），能够以适配器级别的开销高效添加新工具。COTEX定位两组参数方向：一组触发工具调用，从而开启多轮推理轨迹；另一组决定选择哪个工具。新工具的适配器被限制在调用方向上，并通过正交约束确保不影响先前工具的选择。我们进一步引入了一套协议，可将专业模型现有的任务特定标注转换为经过验证的工具使用轨迹。在两个代表性智能体上的实验……
tldr: 提出COTEX方法，通过参数方向定位与正交约束，在适配器层面以低成本为多模态智能体持续扩展新工具，同时保持对已有工具的使用能力。
en_tdlr: COTEX enables continual extension of new tools into multimodal agents at adapter-level cost by locating tool-calling and tool-selection parameter directions and applying orthogonal constraints, preserving existing tool-use abilities.
